_comment: Validate the Fork-B curve fix (fatter-clearance Theta* straightening). 3v3 isengard, continuous L2 (TimeLimit=60 so it never auto-advances), gridall+outroute on throughout so room 36 promotes and QueryVia runs there. curve alternated on/off in 30-min blocks. THREE checks, split the log at the '$nav curve on|off' echoes: (1) MECHANISM — curve-on room-36 'hard-room path shape' len/chord should jump from ~1.04 (chord) toward >1.3 (winding), proving the straightening now preserves the corkscrew; (2) PAYOFF — curve-on room-36 stuck-escalations + via-suspends per hour should DROP; (3) END-TO-END — any captures (a carrier threading room 36). Default is OFF; the A-blocks flip it on.
